children: bioAffinity Technologies is advancing its CyPath® Lung test as a noninvasive option for surveillance of lung cancer patients after curative-intent treatment.
Company announced progress toward using CyPath Lung for post-treatment surveillance to monitor recurrence and new cancers.
CyPath Lung is noninvasive and provides a binary result (unlikely or likely malignancy) to help triage patients for further investigation.
Test has three years of commercial experience and prior detection-setting data: 92% sensitivity, 87% specificity, 99% NPV.
Surveillance need underscored by >680,000 Americans living with prior lung cancer and high recurrence rates for NSCLC.
